title: Taravangian Becomes Odium
summary: Taravangian, the king of Kharbranth, finally achieves his goal: in a moment of supreme intelligence, he manipulates events to become the new vessel of Odium, replacing Rayse.
archivistNote: This represents the first known instance of a Shard changing Vessels not through death or voluntary transfer, but through deliberate manipulation. The implications for our understanding of Shardic bonds are profound.
